name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for accessible home modifications?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a contractor for accessible home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing a contractor for accessible home modifications, look for experience in disability remodeling and universal design principles. Verify they are licensed and insured, and ask for references from previous accessible projects. A good contractor will conduct a thorough assessment of your needs, provide a detailed and transparent estimate, and have a clear communication process. Ensure they understand local building codes and permitting requirements, particularly for accessibility features. Our team meets these criteria, ensuring a reliable and specialized service.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor experienced in accessible design, licensed and insured, with good references, who understands your needs, provides clear estimates, and handles permits.
